name: std::chrono::year::operator++, std::chrono::year::operator--
intro:
Adds or subtracts 1 from the year value.

1,2) Performs *this += std::chrono::years{1};.

3,4) Performs *this -= std::chrono::years{1};.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text:
1,3) A reference to this year after modification.

2,4) A copy of the year made before modification.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: If the result would be outside the range [-32767, 32767], the actual stored value is unspecified.

summary: Adds or subtracts 1 from the year value.
